title: Raw Vector Ingest and Byte Preservation
negative_results: a content_hash that does not bind the raw bytes is refused (invariant 1)
an ingested raw vector may only be a SOURCE_CLAIM; other claim classes are refused
raw_bytes are immutable (frozen dataclass); reassignment raises
empty input and empty ingest_id are refused
digits_only / stripped_of refuse a non-text (binary) vector

claims.statement: A raw vector is ingested with its exact original bytes preserved and immutable, bound by a content hash; normalized, digit-only, and separator-stripped views are derived beside the original, never in place of it (POWER).
Ingest assigns no unit, coordinate, or geographic meaning; the vector stays a SOURCE_CLAIM.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs or personal data
